# NoMoneyGym

## What is NoMoneyGym?
NoMoneyGym is a free Progressive Web App (PWA) for creating custom workout routines using your own exercise videos. It works offline, requires no subscriptions, and stores all data locally on the user's device.

## Key Features
- Create Tabata and circuit training routines with personal exercise videos
- Video trimming to select the active portion of each exercise
- Customizable work/rest intervals and round configuration
- Rest between rounds with configurable duration
- Voice cues and sound alerts during workouts
- Offline-first: works without internet after initial load
- No cloud storage: all videos and data stay on the device (IndexedDB)
- Export/import backup as .zip files
- Bilingual interface: Spanish and English
- Free forever: no subscriptions, no ads, no hidden costs

## Who is it for?
- People who want to exercise at home with no gym membership
- Users who record their own exercise videos or download tutorials
- Anyone looking for a free Tabata/HIIT timer with video guidance
- Fitness enthusiasts who want custom circuit routines without paying for apps

## How it works
1. Record or download exercise videos to your device
2. Upload videos to NoMoneyGym and trim the active portion
3. Organize exercises by muscle group (legs, back, chest, shoulders, arms, core, glutes, cardio)
4. Build circuits by selecting exercises, setting work/rest times, and choosing rounds
5. Play your circuit with video playback, countdown timer, and voice cues

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js as a PWA
- Uses IndexedDB (Dexie) for local storage
- No server-side data processing
- No user accounts required
- Works on any modern browser (mobile and desktop)

## URL
https://nomoneygym.com
